en.title: Best Vlogging Cameras 2026
en.description: DJI put a 1-inch sensor in a $499 pocket gimbal and rewrote the entry point, Sony still owns the lens mount answer, and the Pocket 4P skipped the US entirely. Here is where every vlogging camera lands in August 2026.

zh-tw.title: 最佳 Vlog 相機 2026
zh-tw.description: DJI 把一吋感光元件塞進 NT$14,690 的口袋雲台機，直接改寫入門門檻，Sony 仍守著可換鏡頭這一塊，而 Pocket 4P 整個跳過美國。2026 年八月該買哪台 Vlog 相機，這份排行幫你排好。

en.description: A 1-inch CMOS sensor behind an f/2.0 lens on a three axis mechanical gimbal, recording 4K up to 240fps with 14 stops of dynamic range and 10-bit D-Log M. Carries 107GB of internal storage at 800MB/s, a 1,545mAh battery good for roughly four hours of 1080p, ActiveTrack 7.0, and a body 35% lighter than the Pocket 3.

zh-tw.description: 一吋 CMOS 配 f/2.0 鏡頭，架在三軸機械雲台上，4K 最高 240fps，14 級動態範圍與 10-bit D-Log M。內建 107GB 高速儲存，讀寫 800MB/s，1,545mAh 電池 1080p 可連續錄約四小時，支援 ActiveTrack 7.0，機身比 Pocket 3 輕了 35%。

en.description: An APS-C E-mount body with the same 26MP sensor Sony puts in the a6700, 4K 60p in 10-bit, and 759-point phase detection autofocus with Product Showcase and Background Defocus modes. Stabilization is digital, and the kit pairs it with the retracting 16-50mm F3.5-5.6 OSS II power zoom.

zh-tw.description: APS-C E 接環機身，用的是跟 a6700 同一顆 2,600 萬畫素感光元件，4K 60p 10-bit，759 點相位對焦，商品展示模式與背景散景切換都在。防手震走數位路線，鏡頭組搭的是可伸縮的 16-50mm F3.5-5.6 OSS II 電動變焦。
zh-tw.priceRange: NT$29,980 單機身 / NT$32,980 鏡頭組

en.description: The first dual lens pocket gimbal. A 20mm equivalent f/2.0 main module on a 1-inch sensor claims 17 stops of dynamic range through LOFIC technology, joined by a 60mm equivalent f/1.8 telephoto on a 1/1.28-inch sensor for 3x optical zoom. Adds D-Log 2, 4K/240fps and ActiveTrack 8.0. Sold in Taiwan, Europe, the UK, Canada and Australia, with no official US release.

zh-tw.description: 第一台雙鏡頭口袋雲台機。20mm 等效 f/2.0 主鏡搭一吋感光元件，靠 LOFIC 技術做到 17 級動態範圍，另一顆是 60mm 等效 f/1.8 望遠模組配 1/1.28 吋感光元件，3 倍光學變焦。支援 D-Log 2、4K/240fps 與 ActiveTrack 8.0。台灣六月二十九日開賣，美國則沒有官方上市。
zh-tw.priceRange: NT$19,290 標準套裝 / NT$21,790 Vlog 套裝

en.description: Canon's video first APS-C RF body, built around oversampled 4K, a three microphone array, a Multi-function shoe and an on body power zoom lever for PZ lenses. Ships with a tally lamp, vertical recording support and livestreaming tools aimed squarely at same day publishing.

zh-tw.description: Canon 以錄影為主設計的 APS-C RF 機身，核心是超取樣 4K、三麥克風陣列、多功能熱靴，以及機身上直接做出來的電動變焦撥桿。內建 tally 錄影指示燈、直式錄影支援與直播工具，整台就是為當天拍當天上片而生。

en.description: A Leica co-engineered dual lens gimbal camera weighing 233g, pairing a 1-inch 8K main sensor behind a Summicron lens with a 1/1.3-inch f/2.0 telephoto for 6x lossless zoom. Records 8K30 with Dolby Vision and 10-bit I-Log, shoots 37MP stills, and its 2-inch OLED touchscreen detaches to work as a wireless monitor and remote.

zh-tw.description: 跟 Leica 共同開發的雙鏡頭雲台相機，233 公克，一吋 8K 主感光元件配 Summicron 鏡頭，另一顆是 1/1.3 吋 f/2.0 望遠鏡頭，6 倍無損變焦。8K30 支援 Dolby Vision 與 10-bit I-Log，靜態可拍 3,700 萬畫素，兩吋 OLED 觸控螢幕可以拆下來當無線監看螢幕兼遙控器。
zh-tw.priceRange: NT$22,990 標準套裝 / NT$29,990 創作者套裝

en.description: A 22MP Type 1.4 BSI-CMOS compact with a 16-50mm equivalent ultra wide zoom, DIGIC X processing and a built-in cooling fan that removes recording time limits. Fully articulating screen, 426g body, and the widest framing of any all-in-one vlogging compact on the market.

zh-tw.description: 2,200 萬畫素 1.4 型背照式感光元件，配 16-50mm 等效超廣角變焦與 DIGIC X 處理器，機身內建散熱風扇，錄影時間限制直接解除。翻轉螢幕，426 公克，廣角端是目前一體式 Vlog 隨身機裡最廣的。

en.description: The lightest body in Fujifilm's X series, built around a 26MP X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor, 6.2K open gate video, a three capsule internal microphone with dedicated audio modes, and a physical Film Simulation dial that delivers finished color straight out of camera.

zh-tw.description: Fujifilm X 系列最輕的機身，2,600 萬畫素 X-Trans CMOS 4 感光元件，支援 6.2K open gate 錄影，內建三顆麥克風膠囊與專屬收音模式，機頂那顆實體軟片模擬轉盤讓你直接出片就有成色。

en.description: The 1-inch sensor gimbal camera that defined the category, with a rotating 2-inch touchscreen that flips the camera between horizontal and vertical, 4K 120fps, ActiveTrack 6.0 and a two microphone array with wind reduction. Still on sale at a steep discount now that the Pocket 4 has arrived.

zh-tw.description: 定義了這個品類的一吋感光元件雲台相機，兩吋觸控螢幕一轉就在橫拍與直拍之間切換，4K 120fps、ActiveTrack 6.0，雙麥克風陣列有降風噪。Pocket 4 上市之後它降價幅度很大，現在還在通路上賣。

en.description: A 20MP 1-inch stacked CMOS compact with an 18-50mm equivalent F1.8-4.0 zoom, the widest framing Sony has put in this body, plus the three capsule directional microphone and Product Showcase autofocus the ZV line is known for.

zh-tw.description: 2,000 萬畫素一吋堆疊式 CMOS 隨身機，配 18-50mm 等效 F1.8-4.0 變焦，這是 Sony 在這個機身上做過最廣的一顆，加上 ZV 系列招牌的三膠囊指向性麥克風與商品展示對焦模式。

en.description: The full frame ZV, running the same 12MP sensor as the a7S III and FX3 with 4K 60p, five axis in body stabilization, and AI framing features including Auto Framing and Cinematic Vlog. The low light ceiling here is the highest of any camera on this list.

zh-tw.description: 全片幅的 ZV，用的是跟 a7S III、FX3 同一顆 1,200 萬畫素感光元件，4K 60p，五軸機身防手震，還有 Auto Framing 與電影感 Vlog 這類 AI 構圖功能。夜拍上限是這份榜單裡最高的一台。

en.description: A pocketable 1-inch sensor vlog camera with a built-in kickstand, stereo capture and one button livestreaming, designed to be pointed at yourself on a desk. The cheapest way onto a real sensor if a phone is the alternative.

zh-tw.description: 口袋大小的一吋感光元件 Vlog 機，機身自帶支架，立體聲收音，一鍵直播，設計上就是放在桌上對著自己拍。如果你的替代方案是手機，這是踏進真感光元件最便宜的一條路。

en.commentary: The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 takes first at 9.3 and I think the gimbal category has quietly won the vlogging argument. A three axis mechanical gimbal produces motion that electronic stabilisation approximates and never matches, the subject tracking holds a face while you walk backwards through a crowd, and the whole thing fits in a jacket pocket. For the specific job of filming yourself while moving, that combination beats a larger sensor you have to carry in a bag. Sony ZV-E10 II at 9.1 is the pick when image quality is the deliverable, since an APS-C sensor with interchangeable lenses gives you the shallow depth of field and low light performance a compact cannot reach. If your videos are talking head pieces shot in one place, that is the better camera. Osmo Pocket 4P at 9.0 is the same gimbal design with a wider lens, which matters more than it sounds for close range selfie framing in small rooms. Canon EOS R50 V at 8.8 is the value interchangeable lens option and Canon's autofocus remains outstanding. My practical advice: pick based on whether you move while filming, because that single question separates the top two.

highlights.title: Mechanical gimbals won the moving shot
highlights.body: Three axis stabilisation produces motion that electronic correction approximates and never equals, and subject tracking holds a face while you walk backwards through a crowd. For filming yourself in motion, that beats a larger sensor sitting in a bag at home. The Pocket 4 earns 9.3 on exactly that.

highlights.title: Buy the ZV-E10 II if you film in one place
highlights.body: An APS-C sensor with interchangeable lenses delivers shallow depth of field and low light performance no compact reaches. For talking head videos shot at a desk, image quality is the deliverable and this is the better camera at 9.1. The choice comes down to whether you move.

highlights.title: The wider lens on the 4P matters in small rooms
highlights.body: A wider field of view sounds like a minor specification until you try to frame yourself at arm's length in a small apartment. For creators filming in tight spaces, the 4P at 9.0 is the more practical of the two Pocket models even though it ranks below its sibling.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 拿下第一，9.3 分，我覺得雲台相機已經悄悄贏了 Vlog 這場辯論。

三軸機械雲台做出來的運鏡，電子防手震只能模擬、永遠追不上。主體追蹤能在你倒退穿過人群時鎖住臉，整台還塞得進外套口袋。

就「邊移動邊拍自己」這個特定任務來說，這個組合勝過一顆你得裝在包包裡背著的大感光元件。

Sony ZV-E10 II 9.1 分，畫質就是交付成果的話選它，APS-C 加可換鏡頭給你的淺景深跟低光表現，是隨身機做不到的。影片主要是固定一個地方講話的類型，這台更好。

Osmo Pocket 4P 9.0 分，一樣的雲台設計配上更廣的鏡頭，這件事比聽起來重要，在小房間裡近距離自拍構圖差很多。

Canon EOS R50 V 8.8 分，可換鏡頭裡的高 CP 值選項，Canon 的對焦一如既往地穩。

實用建議，照「你拍的時候會不會移動」來選，這一個問題就分開了前兩名。

highlights.title: 移動鏡頭這一局，機械雲台贏了
highlights.body: 三軸穩定做出來的運鏡，電子修正只能模擬永遠追不上，主體追蹤能在你倒退穿過人群時鎖住臉。邊動邊拍自己的需求，這勝過一顆放在家裡包包裡的大感光元件。Pocket 4 的 9.3 分就在這裡。

highlights.title: 固定一個地方拍就買 ZV-E10 II
highlights.body: APS-C 加可換鏡頭給的淺景深跟低光表現，隨身機到不了。坐在桌前講話的影片，畫質就是交付內容，這台 9.1 分更適合。選擇的關鍵就在你會不會移動。

highlights.title: 4P 的廣角鏡頭在小房間裡差很多
highlights.body: 更廣的視角聽起來像小規格，直到你在小套房裡伸直手臂想把自己框進去。在狹窄空間拍攝的創作者，這台 9.0 分的 4P 其實比它的兄弟機更實用，雖然名次排在後面。

en.commentary: The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 holds first and gimbal stabilization is why it beats cameras with larger sensors. A vlogging camera records while you walk, and mechanical stabilization on three axes produces footage that electronic stabilization cannot match without cropping heavily and introducing warp on the edges of frame. The Pocket 4 also solves the framing problem: subject tracking that actually holds a face while you move means you can shoot alone without checking the screen. Sony's ZV-E10 II at second is the pick when you want interchangeable lenses and real depth of field control, and its autofocus is still the best in the category for face and eye tracking. The Osmo Pocket 4P at third is the wider lens variant, which suits tight interiors. Canon's EOS R50 V at fourth is the best value for anyone stepping up to a proper camera body, and Insta360's Luna Ultra at fifth is the action-oriented option. Choose by how you shoot: gimbal for moving solo, interchangeable lens for controlled setups. Buying the wrong one for your workflow wastes the sensor advantage entirely.

highlights.title: Mechanical stabilization beats a bigger sensor for walking shots
highlights.body: The Osmo Pocket 4 stabilizes on three axes mechanically, which produces smooth footage without the heavy crop and edge warp that electronic stabilization introduces. If most of your shooting happens while moving, that advantage outweighs the low-light benefit of a larger sensor.

highlights.title: Subject tracking is what lets you shoot alone
highlights.body: The Pocket 4 holds a face in frame while you move, so you can film without watching the screen or asking someone to operate the camera. For solo creators, reliable tracking removes the single biggest practical obstacle to shooting anything on the move.

highlights.title: Buy the ZV-E10 II for controlled setups
highlights.body: Interchangeable lenses and genuine depth of field control matter when you shoot seated, on a tripod, in a space you control. Sony's face and eye autofocus is the best here, and in that workflow the gimbal advantage stops mattering while the sensor advantage starts to.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 守住第一，三軸雲台就是它贏過感光元件更大的相機的原因。

Vlog 相機的工作內容是一邊走一邊錄，機械式三軸穩定拍出來的畫面，電子防手震要靠大幅裁切加上邊緣扭曲才勉強追得上。

Pocket 4 還解決了構圖問題。它的主體追蹤是真的能在你移動時把臉留在畫面裡，代表你一個人拍的時候不用一直回頭看螢幕。

Sony ZV-E10 II 排第二，想要可換鏡頭跟真正的景深控制就選它，臉部跟眼部對焦到現在還是這個類別最好的。

Osmo Pocket 4P 第三，廣角版本，台灣的室內空間普遍不大，這個焦段在小房間裡好用很多。

Canon EOS R50 V 第四，要升級到正式相機機身的話 CP 值最高。

Insta360 Luna Ultra 第五，運動取向的選項。

照你的拍攝方式選：一個人邊走邊拍就雲台，可控環境的定點拍攝就可換鏡頭。選錯的話，感光元件的優勢等於整個浪費掉。

highlights.title: 邊走邊拍的話，機械穩定勝過更大的感光元件
highlights.body: Osmo Pocket 4 是機械式三軸穩定，畫面順暢而且不用付出電子防手震那種大幅裁切跟邊緣扭曲的代價。大部分拍攝都在移動中發生的話，這個優勢蓋過大感光元件的低光表現。

highlights.title: 主體追蹤才讓你一個人拍得成
highlights.body: Pocket 4 能在你移動時把臉框在畫面裡，所以你不用盯著螢幕，也不用找人幫你操作相機。對單人創作者來說，可靠的追蹤拿掉了移動拍攝最大的實務障礙。

highlights.title: 可控環境就買 ZV-E10 II
highlights.body: 坐著拍、架腳架、環境你說了算的時候，可換鏡頭跟真正的景深控制才有意義。Sony 的臉部與眼部對焦是這裡最好的，在那種工作流程下雲台的優勢消失，感光元件的優勢才開始發揮。

references.title: Insta360's X6 Reimagines the 360 Shooter as the Everything Camera
Insta360 teases DJI Osmo Pocket rival with dual cameras
GoPro teases a mysterious cinematic camera, which could have DJI and Insta360 worried

en.commentary: The interesting development in this category is that the boundary between action camera makers and traditional camera brands is dissolving, and it is happening in the direction that benefits vloggers. GoPro has teased a cinematic camera that moves the company outside the action body it has occupied for two decades, and Insta360 launched the X6 on August 12 with positioning as an everything camera rather than a 360 specialist. Larger sensors are arriving in bodies small enough to hold at arm's length, and that combination is exactly what this category has needed. The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 holds first at 9.3 and it remains the camera I recommend to most people making video alone. The three-axis mechanical gimbal produces stabilisation that no electronic system matches, because it physically isolates the sensor from your movement rather than cropping and warping the frame afterwards. Walking footage from a Pocket 4 looks like it came off a rig. Add subject tracking that actually holds a face while you move and a form factor that fits in a jacket pocket, and it covers the realistic use case better than a larger camera you leave at home. Sony ZV-E10 II second at 9.1 is the correct choice once you want interchangeable lenses and shallow depth of field. Canon EOS R50 V fourth at 8.8. My advice: buy the microphone before the next camera body, since audio quality determines watch time more than image quality does. No rank or score changes today.

highlights.title: A mechanical gimbal beats electronic stabilisation, and it is not close
highlights.body: The Osmo Pocket 4's three-axis gimbal physically isolates the sensor from your movement rather than cropping and warping the frame in software. Walking footage looks like it came off a rig, with no resolution lost to stabilisation crop. That mechanical advantage is why it holds first at 9.3 over larger-sensor alternatives.

highlights.title: Buy the microphone before you buy the next camera body
highlights.body: Audio quality determines watch time more than image quality does, because viewers tolerate soft footage and leave immediately on bad sound. A dedicated microphone on your current camera improves the finished video more than a sensor upgrade with the built-in mic. This is the highest return purchase in the category.

highlights.title: The category boundary is dissolving in vloggers' favour
highlights.body: GoPro is teasing a cinematic camera outside its traditional action body, and Insta360 launched the X6 on August 12 positioned as an everything camera. Larger sensors are arriving in bodies you can hold at arm's length, which is exactly what solo video creators have needed and what previous generations forced you to choose between.

highlights.title: Step up to the ZV-E10 II when you want depth of field, not resolution
highlights.body: Interchangeable lenses and a larger sensor buy shallow depth of field and low-light capability, which is a look rather than a specification. If your videos would benefit from a genuinely blurred background and better indoor footage, that is the reason to move up. If not, the pocket form factor wins on the footage you actually capture.

zh-tw.commentary:
這個品類最有意思的發展是，運動相機廠商與傳統相機品牌之間的界線正在溶解，而且方向對做影片的人有利。

GoPro 預告了一台電影感相機，走出它待了二十年的運動相機機身，而 Insta360 在 8 月 12 日推出 X6，定位是全能相機而不是 360 專科。更大的感光元件正在進入你伸長手臂就能拿住的機身裡，而這個組合正是這個品類一直缺的。

DJI Osmo Pocket 4 續坐第一 9.3，也依然是我推薦給多數一個人拍片的人的那台。三軸機械雲台的穩定效果是任何電子系統都比不上的，因為它是物理上把感光元件跟你的動作隔離開來，而不是事後裁切扭曲畫面。用 Pocket 4 邊走邊拍出來的畫面，看起來像是架在穩定器上拍的。

再加上真的能在你移動時鎖住人臉的主體追蹤，以及塞得進外套口袋的體積，它比一台你會留在家裡的大相機更符合真實使用情境。

Sony ZV-E10 II 第二 9.1，想要可換鏡頭與淺景深就往上跳。Canon EOS R50 V 第四 8.8。

建議是，買下一台機身之前先買麥克風，音質對觀看時長的影響大過畫質。今天名次分數不動。

highlights.title: 機械雲台贏過電子防手震，而且差距不小
highlights.body: Osmo Pocket 4 的三軸雲台是物理上把感光元件跟你的動作隔離，不是靠軟體裁切扭曲畫面。邊走邊拍出來的畫面像架在穩定器上拍的，而且沒有解析度被防震裁切吃掉。這個機械優勢就是它以 9.3 壓過大感光元件對手的原因。

highlights.title: 買下一台機身之前，先買麥克風
highlights.body: 音質對觀看時長的影響大過畫質，因為觀眾能忍受畫面軟，聲音一爛就立刻離開。在你現在這台相機上裝一支專用麥克風，對成品的改善大過換一顆更大的感光元件卻繼續用內建麥克風。這是這個品類報酬率最高的一筆採購。

highlights.title: 品類界線正在往對創作者有利的方向溶解
highlights.body: GoPro 預告了一台走出傳統運動相機機身的電影感相機，Insta360 也在 8 月 12 日推出定位為全能相機的 X6。更大的感光元件正在進入你能伸長手臂拿住的機身裡，而那正是單人影片創作者一直需要、過去卻只能二選一的東西。

highlights.body: Reporting points to an EOS R6 V sharing its core with the R6 Mark III and the C50 cinema camera, though nothing is buyable yet.

highlights.title: Check endurance before image quality

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 還是第一，這週榜單沒動。它四月接替 Pocket 3 之後，一直是我會直接塞給「今天就想開始拍」的人的那台。雲台防手震拿 9.8，那是實體機械穩定撐出來的，所以邊走邊拍的畫面從記憶卡拉出來就能用。9.6 的直式工作流分數負責另外一半，螢幕可以轉、直幅時感光元件是完整用到的，輸出直式影片不用犧牲解析度。以現在做短影音的節奏來說，這兩件事直接決定你一天能出幾支片。

想要可換鏡頭的話，第二名 Sony ZV-E10 II 的對焦還是我最信任的，9.7 分。主體追蹤能撐過你轉身背對鏡頭再轉回來，這就是一次過跟重拍五次的差別，每週更新的人一年下來省下的時間非常可觀。

Canon 的路線圖值得留意。傳聞指向 EOS R6 V 會跟 R6 Mark III 以及 EOS C50 共用核心，延續電影機功能往混合機下放的趨勢。不過現在還買不到，所以不影響這次排名。

最後，如果你的拍攝時間偏長，請先看續航那一欄。ZV-E1 的畫質 9.8 是全榜最高，卻只排第十，因為 6.0 的續航分數在實拍現場的殺傷力比畫質大得多。

en.commentary: The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 holds first at 9.3 and I want to explain why a pocket gimbal camera beats interchangeable lens options in a vlogging ranking. Stabilisation is the difference between footage people watch and footage they close. A mechanical three axis gimbal produces walking shots that are genuinely smooth in a way electronic stabilisation on a mirrorless body cannot replicate, and it does it without cropping your frame. Combine that with a form factor that fits in a pocket and a rotating screen that lets you frame yourself instantly, and you have a camera you carry every day. The best camera is the one you have with you, and this is the one that passes that test. The Sony ZV-E10 II at 9.1 is the step up when image quality and interchangeable lenses matter more than portability, and its autofocus tracking on faces is dependable. The Canon EOS R50 V at 8.9 is the value entry into interchangeable lens vlogging. My guidance: if you walk while filming, buy the gimbal. If you shoot seated or from a tripod, the larger sensor earns its size.

highlights.title: Mechanical stabilisation beats sensor size for walking shots
highlights.body: A three axis gimbal produces smooth footage without cropping the frame, which electronic stabilisation cannot match. If your videos involve moving while filming, that single capability determines whether the result is watchable, and it earns the Pocket 4 its 9.3.

highlights.title: Portability is a specification
highlights.body: A camera in your bag captures moments a camera at home does not. The Pocket 4 fits a pocket and starts recording in seconds, and that convenience produces more usable footage over a year than a better sensor left behind.

highlights.title: Interchangeable lenses earn their size when you shoot static
highlights.body: Seated pieces to camera and tripod work are where the ZV-E10 II larger sensor and lens options pull decisively ahead. Match the tool to how you actually film rather than to which specification sounds better.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 以 9.3 分守第一。我想解釋一下，為什麼一台口袋雲台相機在 Vlog 排行榜裡贏過可換鏡頭機種。

防手震就是「觀眾看得下去」跟「觀眾直接關掉」的分野。機械式三軸雲台拍出來的行走鏡頭，順到電子防手震在無反機身上做不出來，而且它不用裁切畫面。

再加上放得進口袋的體積、跟一秒就能翻過來自拍構圖的旋轉螢幕，你就得到一台會天天帶著走的相機。最好的相機是你身上那一台，而它通過了這個測試。

Sony ZV-E10 II 9.1 分，畫質跟可換鏡頭比攜帶性重要時就往上升級，它的人臉自動對焦追蹤很可靠。

Canon EOS R50 V 8.9 分，是可換鏡頭 Vlog 的高性價比入門。

建議：邊走邊拍就買雲台機；坐著拍或架腳架拍，大感光元件才撐得起它的體積。

highlights.title: 行走鏡頭裡，機械防震贏過感光元件尺寸
highlights.body: 三軸雲台不裁切畫面就能拍出穩定畫面，這是電子防震追不上的。你的影片如果會邊走邊拍，光這一項就決定了成品能不能看，Pocket 4 的 9.3 分就是這樣賺來的。

highlights.title: 攜帶性本身就是一項規格
highlights.body: 包包裡那台相機拍得到的瞬間，放在家裡那台拍不到。Pocket 4 放得進口袋、幾秒就開始錄，這份方便一年下來累積的可用素材，比一顆被留在家的更好感光元件多得多。

highlights.title: 定點拍攝時，可換鏡頭才撐得起體積
highlights.body: 坐著對鏡頭講話、架腳架拍攝，這些是 ZV-E10 II 的大感光元件跟鏡頭選擇明顯領先的場景。照你實際的拍攝方式選工具，不要照哪個規格聽起來比較厲害選。

en.commentary:
The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 holds first at 9.3 and the gimbal is why. A mechanical three-axis gimbal produces stabilisation that electronic systems approximate without matching, and for walking-and-talking footage, which is the majority of vlogging, that difference is immediately visible. It is also small enough to carry every day, and a camera you have with you produces more usable footage than a better camera at home.

The Sony ZV-E10 II at 9.1 is the pick when image quality is the priority and you are willing to carry a proper camera. Interchangeable lenses and a considerably larger sensor give you shallow depth of field and low light performance the Pocket cannot approach. If your vlogs are planned rather than spontaneous, that is the correct tool.

The Canon EOS R50 V at 8.9 sits between the two sensibly and Canon's autofocus for faces remains excellent.

The thing that improves vlogging footage more than any camera upgrade: audio. Viewers tolerate mediocre video and abandon bad audio within seconds. A basic wireless lavalier costs a fraction of any camera here and will do more for your output than moving up this list. Buy the microphone first, then think about the camera. That order is the single most common mistake in this category.

highlights.title: The mechanical gimbal is the whole argument for the Pocket 4
highlights.body: Three-axis mechanical stabilisation produces results electronic systems approximate without matching, and for walking-and-talking footage that difference is immediately visible. At 9.3 it also stays small enough to carry daily, and a camera you have with you beats a better one left at home.

highlights.title: Buy the microphone before you upgrade the camera
highlights.body: Viewers tolerate mediocre video and abandon bad audio within seconds. A basic wireless lavalier costs a fraction of any camera here and improves your output more than moving up this list. Getting that order wrong is the most common mistake people make in this category.

highlights.title: The ZV-E10 II is right when your vlogs are planned
highlights.body: Interchangeable lenses and a much larger sensor deliver shallow depth of field and low light performance the Pocket cannot approach. At 9.1 it is the correct tool if you set up before you shoot, and the wrong one if your best footage happens spontaneously.

highlights.title: Carry size predicts how much footage you actually capture
highlights.body: The best vlogging moments are unplanned, and a camera in a bag at home captures none of them. Weigh portability heavily rather than treating it as a compromise, because the footage you get is a function of the camera being present far more than of its sensor size.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 守住第一 9.3 分，機械雲台就是原因。

三軸機械雲台做出來的穩定效果，電子防手震只能逼近、追不上，而對「邊走邊講」這種佔了 vlog 大宗的畫面來說，這個差異一眼就看得出來。它也小到可以每天帶著，而一台在你身上的相機，產出的可用素材永遠多過一台放在家裡的更好的相機。

Sony ZV-E10 II 9.1 分，是「畫質優先、而且願意揹一台正經相機」時的選擇。可換鏡頭加上大很多的感光元件，給你的淺景深跟低光表現是 Pocket 追不到的。如果你的 vlog 是計畫好才拍的，那就是正確的工具。

Canon EOS R50 V 8.9 分，位置介於兩者之間很合理，Canon 的人臉對焦一直很強。

有件事對 vlog 素材的提升，比任何相機升級都大：聲音。觀眾容忍得了普通的畫面，但爛聲音幾秒鐘內就會讓人關掉。一支基本的無線領夾麥，價格只是這裡任何一台相機的一小部分，對你成品的幫助卻大過在這張榜上往前爬。

先買麥克風，再考慮相機。順序搞反是這個類別最常見的錯誤。

en.commentary: The DJI Osmo Pocket 4 holds first because its gimbal produces stabilisation that electronic correction cannot match, and stabilisation is what separates footage people watch from footage people scroll past. A mechanical gimbal isolates the sensor from your hand movement physically rather than cropping and warping the image afterward, so you keep full resolution and natural motion. The subject tracking also handles the practical problem of filming yourself without an operator. The Sony ZV-E10 II at second is the interchangeable lens choice and the right pick when image quality and shallow depth of field matter more than pocketability. Its autofocus for video remains the best in this price class. The Osmo Pocket 4P at third extends the same platform. The Canon EOS R50 V at fourth is built specifically for video with excellent colour science, and the Insta360 Luna Ultra at fifth rounds out the top five. IFA opens September 4 with imaging brands present, so autumn announcements are days away. My practical guidance stays the same: audio quality determines whether people finish your video, so budget for a microphone before you upgrade the camera body.

highlights.title: A mechanical gimbal keeps resolution electronic stabilisation crops
highlights.body: Electronic correction crops and warps the image to compensate for movement. The Pocket 4 isolates the sensor physically, so you keep full resolution and natural motion, which is why it leads the category.

highlights.title: Budget for a microphone before a better body
highlights.body: Audio quality determines whether people finish a video, and viewers tolerate mediocre footage far longer than they tolerate bad sound. A good microphone on a modest camera outperforms the reverse every time.

highlights.title: Interchangeable lenses buy depth of field
highlights.body: The ZV-E10 II gives you the shallow focus look that a fixed small sensor cannot produce. If your videos are talking head pieces where subject separation matters, that optical capability is the reason to accept a larger body.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Osmo Pocket 4 排第一，因為它的雲台做出的穩定是電子防手震追不上的，而穩定正是「大家看得下去的影片」跟「被滑掉的影片」之間的分界。

機械雲台是實體隔離你手部的晃動，不是事後裁切扭曲畫面來補償，所以你保有完整解析度跟自然的運動感。它的主體追蹤也解決了「沒有人幫你掌鏡卻要拍自己」這個實際問題。

Sony ZV-E10 II 第二名是可換鏡頭的選擇，畫質跟淺景深比口袋便攜性重要的時候選它。它的錄影自動對焦在這個價位帶還是最好的。

Osmo Pocket 4P 第三名延伸同一個平台。Canon EOS R50 V 第四名是專為錄影打造的，色彩科學很優秀，Insta360 Luna Ultra 第五名補上前五。

IFA 九月四號開展，影像品牌也會到場，秋季發表就在幾天後。

highlights.title: 機械雲台保住電子防手震會裁掉的解析度
highlights.body: 電子修正靠裁切跟扭曲畫面來補償晃動。Pocket 4 是實體隔離感光元件，解析度跟自然運動感都保得住，這就是它領先的原因。

highlights.title: 升級機身之前先編麥克風的預算
highlights.body: 聲音品質決定觀眾看不看得完，而大家對畫面普通的容忍度遠高於對聲音很爛的容忍度。普通機身配好麥克風，永遠贏過反過來。

highlights.title: 可換鏡頭買的是景深
highlights.body: ZV-E10 II 給你固定小感光元件做不出的淺景深。如果你拍的是需要主體分離的講話類影片，這份光學能力就是接受較大機身的理由。
